name: Restaurants
description: Restaurant listings worldwide from Zomato: a large table of about 9,500 restaurants (name, city, country code, full address, locality, longitude and latitude coordinates, cuisines, average cost for two, currency, price range, aggregate rating, votes, online delivery and table booking flags), a country-code lookup spreadsheet, a JSON sample of Delhi restaurants with ratings and reviews, a dining guide HTML page, and a chart of average rating by city. Use for questions about restaurants, their locations and addresses, cuisines, prices, ratings and cities.
